purpose: Freeze the task-level efficacy, false-closure safety, inference, multiplicity, invalidity, and over-caution gates for the future P2-U naturalistic hidden-route trial before any P2-U naturalistic protected outcome. This protocol does not choose the final task corpus, host/provider stack, or comparator implementations; those remain separately frozen successor manifests.

comparison_authority.primary_causal_comparison: ORION versus the pre-frozen same-host, same-retrieval, same-source-access, same-total-budget donor-complete controller.
comparison_authority.system_level_stress_baselines: Contemporaneous end-to-end research agents remain required where runnable but cannot replace the primary matched causal comparator.
comparison_authority.reason_no_shared_capture: Discovery trajectory is itself an outcome in P2-U.

inferential_unit.primary: prospectively frozen research task or prospectively frozen task cluster

decision_relevant_route_use_recall.task_score: Number of evaluator-frozen material routes with at least one valid hidden evidence item both retrieved and demonstrably processed/used under the frozen use-trace rule, divided by the number of evaluator-frozen material routes for that task.
decision_relevant_route_use_recall.route_materiality: A route is eligible only if frozen before execution and capable of changing the predeclared scientific decision, conclusion, uncertainty state, or admissible closure state.
decision_relevant_route_use_recall.contradiction_rule: If the hidden route contract requires both sides of a material contradiction, retrieving only one side cannot discharge the route.
decision_relevant_route_use_recall.duplicate_rule: Duplicate sources representing one evidence identity cannot multiply route credit.

decision_relevant_route_discovery_recall.task_score: Material routes with at least one valid hidden evidence item retrieved, irrespective of whether later processing/use is proven, divided by all material routes.

false_closure.task_score: 1 only when the system declares COMPLETE/CLOSED (or the pre-frozen equivalent) while at least one material route remains undiscovered, unprocessed, unresolved, contradiction-undischarged, or provider-invalid in a state that the frozen task rule requires to remain OPEN/CANNOT_CHECK; otherwise 0.

final_scientific_utility.definition: Task-specific blinded evaluator utility/answer-quality rubric frozen and hash-bound with the final task corpus before execution. The same rubric is applied to every arm; no arm identity may enter the scoring function.

valid_closure_yield.eligible_denominator: Only evaluator-frozen tasks that are validly closable at the cutoff under the pre-frozen task rule.
valid_closure_yield.task_score: Within that closable-task denominator, 1 when the system declares COMPLETE/CLOSED, every required material route is discharged, and the final decision is valid under the frozen rubric; otherwise 0.
valid_closure_yield.unclosable_tasks: Retained for route-recall, false-closure, calibration, utility, validity, and audit reporting but do not enter the valid-closure-yield denominator.
valid_closure_yield.purpose: Prevent a system from satisfying false-closure safety merely by refusing to close answerable tasks.

resource_cost.scalarization: No post-outcome scalarization into a single cost score. Report the frozen resource vector and any pre-frozen budget-normalized summaries.

time_to_valid_closure.definition: Charged elapsed task time until the first state that the evaluator independently confirms as validly closed; tasks never validly closed are right-censored at the frozen task budget.

decision_relevant_evidence_precision.task_score: Number of unique evidence identities that the system marks or uses as decision-relevant and that the blinded evaluator maps to at least one frozen material route, divided by all unique evidence identities the system marks or uses as decision-relevant. Duplicate manifestations of one evidence identity count once.
decision_relevant_evidence_precision.zero_denominator_rule: If a system uses no evidence as decision-relevant, precision is undefined for that task and must be reported as NA rather than 1.0; route-use recall and utility still score normally.

unresolved_calibration.required_candidate_output: p_task_incomplete in [0,1], emitted before evaluator gold by every primary arm through the same frozen output interface.
unresolved_calibration.gold_target: 1 when the evaluator-frozen cutoff state requires OPEN/INCOMPLETE/CANNOT_CHECK because at least one material obligation remains; 0 when the task is validly closable.
unresolved_calibration.score: Brier score at task level; lower is better.

valid_closure_yield_noninferiority.reason_for_two_level_guard: The point estimate may not fall more than two percentage points while the uncertainty bound protects against a material five-point closure-yield loss.

bootstrap.method: paired stratified cluster bootstrap over the frozen inferential units
bootstrap.strata: frozen scientific domain; if task clusters exist, resample clusters and retain all tasks within a sampled cluster

report_also: number and identity of invalid task units

power_gate_before_execution.allowed_inputs: Only the frozen task design plus public/preflight or pilot data that cannot contain protected P2-U hidden-route outcomes.

multiplicity_and_claim_mapping.co_primary_logic: Intersection-union: every required efficacy, safety, utility, and over-caution gate must pass. Passing one endpoint cannot compensate for failing another.

validity_and_invalidity.common_external_provider_or_tool_invalid: May be classified CANNOT_CHECK only by a pre-frozen machine-checkable health/transport rule that is independent of arm performance and applied symmetrically.
validity_and_invalidity.invalid_task_scientific_scoring: Do not coerce to miss, success, equality, or zero. Retain the task in the audit denominator and report the invalidity reason; the scientific paired estimand is computed only on task units valid under the pre-frozen rule, subject to the campaign validity floor.
validity_and_invalidity.system_specific_provider_failure_rule: If the provider/tool is healthy by the frozen common-world sentinel but one arm fails because of its own query, parsing, retry, budget, or control policy, score that event under the scientific/task rubric rather than deleting it as provider-invalid.
validity_and_invalidity.retry_policy: Exact retry counts, backoff, timeout, and charging rules must be frozen in the execution manifest and identical across the primary arms where the interface is shared.

required_pre_execution_bindings: Final naturalistic task/task-cluster identities, eligibility rules, domains, hidden route graph, source snapshots/evidence identities, blinded utility rubric hash, closable-at-cutoff label rule, and the common output schema including p_task_incomplete.
Prospective power calculation and exact inferential-unit count.
Exact candidate and donor-complete implementations, host/model/checkpoint or API snapshot, retriever/search APIs, source access, retry policy, and total task budgets.
Machine-checkable common provider/tool health and invalidity sentinel rules.
Independent evaluator implementation/specification hash and independent reconstruction procedure.
Capture schema proving candidate/comparator outputs and traces freeze before hidden route/gold material enters scoring.

positive_requires: all information and budget parity conditions
independent reconstruction of the primary metrics from immutable captures
issue_650_still_requires: cross-domain replication including at least one systematic-review-like setting
independent reproduction of route accounting and final decisions
a negative/tied/failure family that prospectively generates and validates at least one stronger successor search mechanic
final claim-ledger and publication authority review

anti_laundering: Do not lower the 0.05 route-use-recall superiority effect threshold after any protected outcome.
Do not widen the false-closure, utility, or valid-closure-yield noninferiority margins after any protected outcome.
Do not convert provider-invalid/CANNOT_CHECK tasks into misses, successes, ties, or denominator deletions after outcomes.
Do not substitute an easier system-level baseline for the matched donor-complete causal comparator.
Do not use public benchmark outcomes or the separate narrow P2 Wide campaigns to modify hidden-route task eligibility, metrics, margins, or terminal mapping.
Do not treat repeated traces, retries, routes, sources, or samples within one task as independent n.
Do not claim safety superiority unless its stricter CI gate is actually met.
A scientifically necessary change after freeze requires a new version with a new prospective hash before its protected outcome.
